rationale: LULU has gapped down ~19.4% on heavy volume (7x relative), and while the last several 5-minute candles show a modest recovery above the 5-min VWAP ($100.35) and 9-EMA ($100.98), the session VWAP at $108.67 represents massive overhead supply from trapped longs, creating a strong ceiling that makes a long thesis structurally weak. A short entry here risks chasing a move already 79 minutes old with the stock sitting at 63.5% of its intraday range and showing stabilization; the 5-min ATR of only $0.20 indicates tight consolidation that offers insufficient reward relative to the gap noise. With only $841 of daily loss budget remaining, the asymmetric risk of a poorly-defined setup in a post-earnings crash environment does not justify a position.
